package decisionfixture

// This driver is added conformance code. Every production file beside it is
// byte-exact final01 696ac49 production source. This new control-ticket driver is outside the immutable production closure.
import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	decision "github.com/ruipengliu/lerna/components/decision_engine"
	v "github.com/ruipengliu/lerna/contract/v1_1"
	"github.com/ruipengliu/lerna/runtime"
)

type final01Migration struct {
	Version  int64  `json:"version"`
	Checksum string `json:"checksum"`
}
type final01ControlCase struct {
	Name              string                      `json:"name"`
	SourceSchema      string                      `json:"source_schema"`
	DecisionSchema    string                      `json:"decision_schema"`
	SourceOwner       v.OwnerRef                  `json:"source_owner"`
	Request           json.RawMessage             `json:"request"`
	Subject           json.RawMessage             `json:"subject"`
	GetRequest        json.RawMessage             `json:"get_request"`
	CommandGetRequest json.RawMessage             `json:"command_get_request"`
	AcceptedReceipt   json.RawMessage             `json:"accepted_receipt"`
	DecisionBefore    json.RawMessage             `json:"decision_before"`
	Migrations        []final01Migration          `json:"migrations"`
	PublishedRefs     []v.ContentRef              `json:"published_refs"`
	PublishedBodies   []string                    `json:"published_bodies"`
	Planned           []final01ControlPublication `json:"planned"`
	WritersDrained    bool                        `json:"writers_drained"`
}
type final01ControlReady struct {
	Protocol string               `json:"protocol"`
	Cases    []final01ControlCase `json:"cases"`
}

func TestFrozenFinal01ControlWriter(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 55*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	ready := final01ControlReady{Protocol: "lerna-final01-control-696ac49-1"}
	for _, name := range []string{"accepted", "running", "prepared_waiting", "completed", "failed", "publication_running"} {
		world := NewWorld(t, ctx)
		scene := world.Scenario()
		service := world.Service()
		var publisher *final01ControlPublisher
		var err error
		if name == "failed" {
			scene.Request.Payload.Limits.MaxOutputBytes = "0"
		}
		if name == "publication_running" || name == "prepared_waiting" || name == "completed" {
			publisher = &final01ControlPublisher{Publisher: world.source, refusePublication: name == "prepared_waiting"}
			service, err = decision.New(decision.Config{Owner: v.OwnerRef{TenantID: scene.DecisionRef.TenantID, OwnerID: scene.DecisionRef.OwnerID}, Store: world.store, Authority: world.source, Source: world.source, Publisher: publisher, Component: scene.Request.Payload.ComponentRef, Worker: "final01-original-worker", Lease: 2 * time.Second, PoolControl: true})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		request, err := v.Encode(scene.Request)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		received, err := service.Decide(ctx, request, &scene.Subject)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		outcome, ok := received.AsReceived()
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("old writer did not durably receive")
		}
		if _, ok = outcome.Receipt.AsAccepted(); !ok {
			t.Fatal("old writer did not accept")
		}
		if name == "running" {
			claim, err := service.Claim(ctx)
			if err != nil || claim == nil {
				t.Fatalf("old running claim: %v", err)
			}
			if _, err = service.Start(ctx, claim.Claim); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		if name == "publication_running" || name == "prepared_waiting" {
			claim, err := service.Claim(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal("old publication claim failed:", err)
			}
			if claim == nil {
				t.Fatal("old publication claim missing")
			}
			if name == "publication_running" {
				publisher.until = claim.Claim.LeaseUntil.Add(5 * time.Millisecond)
			}
			err = service.RunClaim(ctx, claim.Claim)
			if name == "publication_running" {
				qualified := errors.Is(err, runtime.ErrClaim)
				for cause, depth := err, 0; qualified && cause != nil; depth++ {
					if depth == 32 {
						qualified = false
						break
					}
					if joined, ok := cause.(interface{ Unwrap() []error }); ok {
						causes := joined.Unwrap()
						if len(causes) != 1 {
							qualified = false
							break
						}
						cause = causes[0]
					} else {
						cause = errors.Unwrap(cause)
					}
				}
				if !qualified {
					t.Fatal("old publication Finish qualification failed or included other causes:", err)
				}
				if len(publisher.refs) != 2 {
					t.Fatal("old publication window missing actual source outputs")
				}
			} else {
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if len(publisher.refs) != 0 || len(publisher.planned) != 2 {
					t.Fatal("original prepared publication boundary missing")
				}
			}
		}
		if name == "completed" || name == "failed" {
			result, err := service.Step(ctx)
			if err != nil || result.Processed != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("old completion: %v", err)
			}
		}
		before, err := service.Get(ctx, scene.GetJSON, &scene.Subject)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		found, ok := before.AsFound()
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("old fact unavailable")
		}
		switch name {
		case "accepted":
			if _, ok := found.Decision.AsAccepted(); !ok {
				t.Fatal("old accepted state missing")
			}
		case "running", "publication_running":
			if _, ok := found.Decision.AsRunning(); !ok {
				t.Fatal("old running state missing")
			}
		case "prepared_waiting":
			if _, ok := found.Decision.AsWaiting(); !ok {
				t.Fatal("old prepared waiting state missing")
			}
		case "failed":
			if _, ok := found.Decision.AsFailed(); !ok {
				t.Fatal("old actual output-limit failure missing")
			}
		case "completed":
			if _, ok := found.Decision.AsCompleted(); !ok {
				t.Fatal("old completed state missing")
			}
		}
		subject, err := v.Encode(scene.Subject)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		receipt, err := v.Encode(outcome.Receipt)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		decision, err := v.Encode(found.Decision)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		versions, err := world.store.MigrationVersions(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		migrations := make([]final01Migration, len(versions))
		for i, version := range versions {
			migrations[i] = final01Migration{version.Version, version.Checksum}
		}
		// Close the real writers and confirm drain before transmitting their exact
		// CREATE-success identities. Original admin handles remain owned by World.
		if err = world.store.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		world.store = nil
		if err = world.source.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		world.source = nil
		if !world.decisionOwned || !world.owns {
			t.Fatal("old CREATE ownership missing")
		}
		var refs []v.ContentRef
		var bodies []string
		if publisher != nil {
			refs = publisher.refs
			bodies = publisher.bodies
		}
		var planned []final01ControlPublication
		if publisher != nil {
			planned = publisher.planned
		}
		ready.Cases = append(ready.Cases, final01ControlCase{Planned: planned, PublishedRefs: refs, PublishedBodies: bodies, Name: name, SourceSchema: world.cfg.Schema, DecisionSchema: world.decisionCfg.Schema, SourceOwner: world.owner, Request: request, Subject: subject, GetRequest: scene.GetJSON, CommandGetRequest: scene.CommandGetJSON, AcceptedReceipt: receipt, DecisionBefore: decision, Migrations: migrations, WritersDrained: true})
	}
	bytes, err := json.Marshal(ready)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(bytes) > 128*1024 {
		t.Fatal("ready frame exceeds finite bound")
	}
	if _, err = fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, "LERNA_LEGACY_READY %s\n", bytes); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	released := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(io.LimitReader(os.Stdin, 32))
		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 32), 32)
		if !scanner.Scan() {
			released <- fmt.Errorf("legacy release missing")
			return
		}
		if scanner.Text() != "RELEASE" {
			released <- fmt.Errorf("legacy release invalid")
			return
		}
		released <- scanner.Err()
	}()
	select {
	case err := <-released:
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "historical RELEASE unconfirmed; retain acknowledged scopes")
			os.Exit(2)
		}
	case <-ctx.Done():
		_ = os.Stdin.Close()
		select {
		case <-released:
		case <-time.After(time.Second):
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "historical RELEASE deadline; retain acknowledged scopes")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	// NewWorld's owned t.Cleanup executes now, including the retained admins.
}

// All bodies, refs and keys are observed through this original Publisher port.
// Refusal happens before its independent write; the delayed case really reads
// both persisted outputs then crosses the original acquired lease before Finish.
type final01ControlPublication struct {
	Key     string         `json:"key"`
	Body    []byte         `json:"body"`
	Sources []v.ContentRef `json:"sources"`
	Ref     v.ContentRef   `json:"ref"`
}
type final01ControlPublisher struct {
	decision.Publisher
	until             time.Time
	refusePublication bool
	planned           []final01ControlPublication
	refs              []v.ContentRef
	bodies            []string
}

func (p *final01ControlPublisher) PlanPublication(ctx context.Context, key string, body []byte, sources []v.ContentRef, permission decision.Permission) (v.ContentRef, error) {
	ref, err := p.Publisher.PlanPublication(ctx, key, body, sources, permission)
	if err == nil {
		p.planned = append(p.planned, final01ControlPublication{Key: key, Body: append([]byte(nil), body...), Sources: append([]v.ContentRef(nil), sources...), Ref: ref})
	}
	return ref, err
}
func (p *final01ControlPublisher) Publish(ctx context.Context, key string, body []byte, sources []v.ContentRef, permission decision.Permission) (v.ContentRef, error) {
	if p.refusePublication {
		return v.ContentRef{}, fmt.Errorf("controlled fixture unavailable before original publication")
	}
	ref, err := p.Publisher.Publish(ctx, key, body, sources, permission)
	if err != nil {
		return ref, err
	}
	actual, err := p.Publisher.ReadPublished(ctx, ref, permission)
	if err != nil {
		return ref, err
	}
	if string(actual) != string(body) {
		return ref, fmt.Errorf("old publication readback differs")
	}
	p.refs = append(p.refs, ref)
	p.bodies = append(p.bodies, string(actual))
	return ref, nil
}
func (p *final01ControlPublisher) ReadPublished(ctx context.Context, ref v.ContentRef, permission decision.Permission) ([]byte, error) {
	body, err := p.Publisher.ReadPublished(ctx, ref, permission)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err = v.Decode[v.Proposal](body); err == nil && !p.until.IsZero() {
		timer := time.NewTimer(time.Until(p.until))
		defer timer.Stop()
		select {
		case <-timer.C:
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return nil, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
	return body, nil
}
